differential.name: End-stage renal disease due to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stage 4) with high creatinine, proteinuria, diabetes and pending transplant indicate ESRD from diabetic kidney disease.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Long‑standing hypertension and CKD progression are classic for hypertensive‑induced renal damage.

differential.name: Acute on chronic kidney injury (e.g., volume overload, nephrotoxic medication)
differential.rationale: Recent weight loss after dialysis (3.8 kg) and pain score suggest an acute insult superimposed on chronic disease.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia and CKD stage 4 commonly cause normocytic anemia from reduced erythropoietin.

differential.name: Adjustment disorder with depressed mood
differential.rationale: Stress, social isolation, and full‑time employment in a young adult awaiting transplant predispose to an adjustment reaction.
